title: A logarithmic lower bound
statement: Let $s \in \bbn$ be a positive integer and let $\varepsilon \in \bbr$ satisfy $0 < \varepsilon \le 1$. Then \[ 1 \le \log_2\!\left(\frac{2s}{\varepsilon}\right). \]
hypotheses_covered: s a natural number with 0 < s
replaced:
For $s \in \bbn$ with $0 < s$ and $\varepsilon \in \bbr$ with $0 < \varepsilon \le 1$,
the quantity $l = \log_2(2s/\varepsilon)$ satisfies $1 \le l$.
